payload.core_mechanism_summary: Uses first edge (a,b) to find a vertex c adjacent to both, then assigns vertices to sets based on adjacency to a,b,c, verifying no intra-set edges and complete inter-set edge counts.
payload.rationale: Solution is constructive, not a search. Among available subtypes, search_dfs_bfs_graph is the closest as it processes graph structure, but no traversal is used. Confidence is low due to mismatch.
